description: Screenshot of a public web page as a PNG, rendered by the thum.io screenshot service. Returns the image URL plus the PNG width and height measured from the image. Only http/https pages; the caller fetches screenshotUrl. Third-party renderer, rate limits apply. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
